headline: Besler grows through innovation in the first half of the year, raising its turnover to 19.6 billion TL
summary: Besler's consolidated turnover in the first six months of 2026 rose 7.6% year on year to 19.6 billion lira. The company attributes the result to innovation and its leading brands.
why: Besler is a Turkish food producer active in frozen food, frozen bakery, canned food and edible oils, so its results signal demand in Turkey's packaged food sector.
